question.problem:
Find ${lim}_{x\to {0}^{-}}f(x)$ and ${lim}_{x\to {(\pi /2)}^{+}}f(x)$ for the function given by

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}2\operatorname{sec}⁡x & \text{ for }\,-\frac{\pi }{2}<x<0 \\ \operatorname{cot}⁡x+x & \text{ for }\,\frac{\pi }{2}\le x<\pi .\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
Approaching $x=0$ from the left, we have $x<0,$ so we use the expression $f(x)=2\operatorname{sec}⁡x.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to {0}^{-}}f(x) & ={lim}_{x\to {0}^{-}}2\operatorname{sec}⁡x \\  & =2\operatorname{sec}⁡0 \\  & =2(1) \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Approaching $x=\frac{\pi }{2}$ from the right, we have $x>\frac{\pi }{2},$ so we use the expression $f(x)=\operatorname{cot}⁡x+x.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to {(\pi /2)}^{+}}f(x) & ={lim}_{x\to {(\pi /2)}^{+}}(\operatorname{cot}⁡x+x) \\  & =\operatorname{cot}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})+\frac{\pi }{2} \\  & =0+\frac{\pi }{2} \\  & =\frac{\pi }{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
